name: Zompaynco
desc: A member of the Saurian Relics Association. Originally moving to Nod-Krai to investigate ruins tied to saurian relics, he can now be found standing by any heat source after failing to adapt to the colder climate.

value.text:
Collective of Plenty
Saurian Relics Association

customize.text:
<color=#ffd680>Stage Introduction</color>
To remind himself why he began searching for Saurian Relics in the first place, Zompaynco built a deck centered around them. Though he can no longer recall his original intent, his mastery of the deck has grown with time. Beating him won't be easy.
<color=#ccbfad>Special Rule: Start with 1 "Tonatiuh" card on the opponent's side of the field.</color>
